OVERVIEW: A utility to interact with iOS Simulators and Android
emulators/devices and extract accessibility information.

USAGE: sim-use <subcommand>

OPTIONS:
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.

SUBCOMMANDS:
  describe-ui, ui         Describes the UI hierarchy of a booted simulator
                          using accessibility information.
  devices                 List connected devices across iOS Simulators and
                          Android devices.
  list-simulators         List iOS Simulators (legacy; use 'sim-use devices'
                          for cross-platform listing).
  init                    Install sim-use skill files for detected AI clients.
  tap                     Tap on a specific point on the screen, or locate an
                          element by accessibility and tap its center.
  long-press              Long-press an element by alias, selector, or
                          coordinate (default hold 0.8s).
  type                    Type text by entering a sequence of characters.
  paste                   Paste text into the focused field via the simulator
                          pasteboard (bypasses IME).
  keyboard-state          Report whether the on-screen software keyboard is
                          currently visible.
  swipe                   Perform a swipe gesture from one point to another on
                          the screen.
  button                  Press a hardware button on the simulator or Android
                          device.
  touch                   Perform precise touch down/up events at specific
                          coordinates.
  gesture                 Perform preset gesture patterns on the simulator.
  multi-touch             Dispatch a two-finger gesture with explicit start /
                          end positions for each finger.
  record-video            Record the simulator display to an MP4 file using
                          H.264 encoding
  screenshot              Capture a screenshot from the simulator display and
                          save it as a PNG file
  app-state               Report which apps are running on the device; --reset
                          re-baselines crash detection.
  viewer                  Open the Viewer in your browser: visualise the live
                          UI tree of a booted simulator alongside what sim-use
                          sees.
  daemon                  Manage the sim-use background daemon that amortises
                          per-call init cost.
  ios                     iOS Simulator-specific subcommands.
  android                 Android-specific subcommands (init, describe-ui,
                          devices, tap, …)

  See 'sim-use help <subcommand>' for detailed help.

OVERVIEW: Perform a swipe gesture from one point to another on the screen.

USAGE: sim-use swipe [<options>] [<x,y> ...]

ARGUMENTS:
  <x,y>                   Optional positional coordinate pairs: <from x,y> <to
                          x,y>. Exclusive with --from/--to and
                          --start-x/--start-y/--end-x/--end-y.

OPTIONS:
  --from <x,y>            Starting coordinate pair.
  --to <x,y>              Ending coordinate pair.
  --start-x <start-x>     The X coordinate of the starting point.
  --start-y <start-y>     The Y coordinate of the starting point.
  --end-x <end-x>         The X coordinate of the ending point.
  --end-y <end-y>         The Y coordinate of the ending point.
  --duration <duration>   Duration of the swipe in seconds.
  --delta <delta>         Distance between touch points in pixels.
  --pre-delay <pre-delay> Delay before starting the swipe in seconds.
  --post-delay <post-delay>
                          Delay after completing the swipe in seconds.
  --device <device>       Target device — iOS Simulator UDID or Android adb
                          serial. Auto-detected by string shape. Optional —
                          defaults to the only booted iOS simulator on the host
                          (or to the SIM_USE_DEVICE / SIM_USE_UDID env var when
                          set).
  --udid <udid>           Deprecated alias for --device. Still accepted; may be
                          removed in a future release.
  --json                  Emit the result as compact JSON instead of the
                          human-readable success line.
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.
